create_mesh_box: create a TriangleMesh box with given width, height, depth and texture type
create_mesh_sphere: create a TriangleMesh sphere with given radius, texture type and resolution
create_mesh_cylinder: create a TriangleMesh cylinder with given radius, height, texture type and resolution
create_mesh_hemisphere: create a TriangleMesh hemisphere with given radius, texture type and resolution
generate_mesh_config: generate a mesh config dict from mujoco geom type, name and size parameters
